summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) furnished a Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, attaching a press release announcing completion of Phase 1 of an AI-powered Digital Twin program developed with Germany's AI engineering GmbH. Phase 1 produced a physics-based model of wave-floater interaction, load and energy-forecast simulations, and initial machine-learning capability; both parties are NVIDIA Inception members, and NVIDIA Networking issued a support letter. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation; watch only for commercialization or financing disclosures.
